key_impacts: Nuclear fuel melted inside the reactors due to the accident.
Coolant water became extremely contaminated and leaked into reactor building basements.
Large volumes of contaminated water have been stored in on-site tanks at Fukushima Daiichi.
People were affected by the disaster, prompting calls for comprehensive health surveys.
Complete decontamination is stated to be impossible, indicating persistent contamination.
evidence_snippets: “large-scale nuclear disaster at the ... Fukushima Daiichi ... directly caused by the Great East Japan Earthquake and Tsunami of March 11, 2011.”
“cool the nuclear fuel that melted inside the nuclear reactors due to the accident.”
“coolant water… becomes extremely contaminated… and then leaks into the basement… [the site] has been completely packed with 1,000 ton capacity tanks containing the contaminated water.”
missing_information: Impact numbers (casualties, displaced, economic losses) not provided.
Specific directly impacted settlements beyond the plant are not named.
Exact end date or duration of the acute accident phase not specified.
